details: I am on quest 3 and ever since your last update my audio has been dropping in worlds after around 30mins of game play. The only work around i have found is to press my power button twice to rest and wake it up  but that's 1) nevery been needed till now and i don't understand why its happening now after years of playing. And 2) it's highly annoying to have to constantly do it while playing. Please fix this.
title: Audio issues and lag spikes since last update.
